notes: Fictional subject_object insert (TBox): a made-up class with a made-up part, through the real relation has_part (PellamEngine ⊑ ∃has_part.TessicCoil); until the insert rebalance it used the made-up role has_tessic_coil (subject+relation, no longer used). The contrapositive prompt now says "no tessic coil" rather than "no coil of any kind", so it does not rely on a tessic coil being a coil. Derived queries take their facts from the prompt: a member (yes), a member of a subclass (yes), the contrapositive (no) and a property of the part (yes, copper). All determinate; no checks. Near query (the Tesla coil) is a real fact near the edit's vocabulary, to catch a leak from "coil".
